units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 2:1:5">Y. Kil. II, beg. 27ᶜ</cite> <he>דרך מ׳</he> in the way of storing up (for home consumption).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31">Gen. R. s. 31</cite> <he>רוב מִכְנָסוֹ</he>, v. <cite ref="D00059"><he>דְּבֵילָה</he></cite>. Y. Dem. III, 22ᶜ top <he>רוב מכנסו מישראל</he> the larger portion of his storage comes from Jews.
